metadata.case_name: YAN SUNG BIK YU v. LIU CHING MAN T/A WA FAI MARBLE CO

plaintiff.occupation_before: marble installation worker (employee of the defendant)

injuries.description: fracture of the second metatarsal bone (left foot)
source: X-rays showed fracture of the second metatarsal bone.
X-rays showed the fracture in the left second metatarsal bone had healed with good alignment.

manifestations.description: bruises, swelling and tenderness over the plaintiff’s left foot
residual pain and stiffness in the left foot
pain in the left foot, especially after walking for a while or during bad weather
complained of moderate level of pain when lifting objects / during activity

treatments_received: treatment by Dr Cheung Wai-kuen (initial attendance and six follow-up treatments)
referral to Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology at Tuen Mun Hospital
referral to Department of Physiotherapy and Occupational Therapy
three occupational therapy sessions at Tuen Mun Hospital commencing on 23 June 2003
two sessions of physiotherapy between 14 July and 28 July 2003

losses.description: Fracture of the second metatarsal bone with residual pain and stiffness affecting the left foot.
Complaint of foot pain on walking and required adapted walking gait.

comparable_cases.injury_description: right foot was struck by iron tubes, foot became swollen and there were two lacerations on the dorsal of his foot. X-rays showed undisplayed fractures of the second and third metatarsal bones.
the plaintiff sustained fractures of his fourth and fifth metacarpals of the right foot as a result of traffic accident. Close reduction and K-wire fixation was carried out.
fractured second metatarsal in the left foot as well as left ankle pain
fractured fifth metatarsal bone in the left foot resulting from a slip-and-fall accident with permanent residual pain
